flashcard_questions.q: The third person of the Trinity; God's active presence in the world.
Greek 'Logos'; used in John's Gospel to refer to Jesus Christ, who existed with God from the beginning.
Rising from the dead; Christians believe Jesus was resurrected and that believers will also be raised to new life.

flashcard_questions.a: God's assessment of a person's life to determine their eternal destiny in heaven or hell.
The state of eternal happiness in the presence of God, the ultimate reward for the faithful.
